fact: PREA says on 17 February 2026 that the e-Government Procurement strategy is validated and an implementation firm is about to be deployed, with iteration 1 of the e-GP going live in 2026.
ARMP and UNDP trained 1,039 central actors on the new e-GP platform and 460 on its e-Planning module, which is due to be functional for the 2023 budget year, as e-GP progressively replaces the SIGMP.
UNDP formally handed the e-GP online procurement platform to Madagascar's procurement regulator ARMP; until then 70% of the process was manual and 30% ran on the SIGMP software.
